roadmap.focus: Master Python syntax, OOP concepts, list comprehensions, exception handling, and virtual environments.
Build RESTful APIs using Flask or FastAPI; handle routing, request validation, authentication, and HTTP status codes.
Work with SQL databases (PostgreSQL/SQLite), design relational schemas, write queries, and integrate SQLAlchemy.
Write PyTest test suites, containerize apps with Docker, and deploy microservices with Gunicorn to cloud servers.
Linear algebra, multivariable calculus, probability, NumPy matrix math, and Pandas feature engineering.
Regression, classification, decision trees, random forests, clustering, cross-validation, and metrics (Precision, Recall, ROC-AUC).
Neural network architectures, PyTorch tensors, backpropagation, and text preprocessing using TF-IDF and tokenizers.
Packaging models into inference endpoints using FastAPI, containerization, and monitoring performance in production.
Semantic layout tags, Flexbox, CSS Grid, media queries, CSS variables, and accessibility best practices.
DOM manipulation, closures, promises, async/await, fetch API, array methods, and modular code organization.
Component lifecycles, useState, useEffect, custom hooks, props drilling vs context API, and routing.
Typing React components, optimizing bundle sizes, unit testing with Jest/React Testing Library, and production build tooling.
VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot tables, descriptive statistics, financial modeling formulas, and conditional logic.
Complex JOINS, aggregations, GROUP BY, subqueries, CTEs, and window functions on PostgreSQL/MySQL.
Building interactive dashboards in Power BI or Tableau, KPI card creation, data modeling, and executive reports.
Data wrangling with Pandas, plotting with Matplotlib/Seaborn, and generating automated automated summary spreadsheets.
File permissions, systemd services, networking fundamentals (DNS, TCP/IP, SSH), and Bash automation scripts.
Dockerfiles, multi-stage builds, container networking, volumes, and multi-service docker-compose setups.
Core AWS services (EC2, S3, IAM, VPC), automated GitHub Actions/GitLab CI testing, and deployment jobs.
Deployments, Services, Ingress, Pod autoscaling, and managing cloud resources reproducibly with Terraform.
OSI model, packet structures, firewalls, ports, protocols, Linux security configurations, and permissions.
Log analysis, intrusion detection (IDS/IPS), monitoring security events using Splunk/ELK, and threat intelligence.

roadmap.focus: OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities (SQLi, XSS, CSRF), scanning with Nmap/Nessus, and basic remediation practices.
Incident triage, containment playbooks, forensic evidence preservation, and ISO 27001 / NIST frameworks.
Conducting interviews, workshop facilitation, translating business pain points into structured user stories.
BPMN 2.0 flowcharts, Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), functional specifications, and wireframes.
Scrum ceremonies, backlog grooming, sprint planning, Jira workflow configuration, and release tracking.
Validating hypotheses using SQL queries, facilitating User Acceptance Testing, and managing change adoption.
Top/Middle/Bottom funnel stages, buyer persona mapping, brand positioning, and content messaging.
Keyword research, technical on-page SEO, link architecture, search intent matching, and content creation.
Google Search ads, Meta campaign structure, audience targeting, ad creatives, and bidding strategies.
